blurb: Waterfront Park is a non-profit, public park in Louisville, Kentucky, connecting people to the river and providing a community space. The park features public art, playgrounds, picnic areas, and the Big Four Bridge pedestrian and bicycle bridge. It hosts free concerts, history walking tours, and special events like Wine on the River.
extraNote: No admission fee for park entry; some events may charge admission · Park open daily 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. · No personal grills; park grills available in picnic areas · No camping allowed · Big Four Bridge closed during icy weather and certain events · Waterfront Wednesday is rain or shine unless dangerous weather
